sources.method: Entry-level search locator used for orientation only; specific statements are checked against the higher-tier reference and official records where available.

statement.zh: **术语**：格密码（Lattice-based Cryptography）。FIPS 203 定义 KEM 为「a cryptographic scheme that, under certain conditions, can be used to establish a shared secret key between two communicating parties」，由 KeyGen、Encaps 与确定性 Decaps 三个算法组成，并说明「The security of ML-KEM is based on the presumed hardness of the so-called Module Learning with Errors (MLWE) problem」。同族的 FIPS 204 对 ML-DSA 采用带环参数的 MLWE 问题（副本把那个参数印成丢失的数学字形，故只转述不复引）加上称为 SelfTargetMSIS 的 MSIS 非标准变体。
statement.en: **Term**: Lattice-based Cryptography.It is registered under post-quantum cryptography, asymmetric public-key cryptography.

statement.zh: 标准先把底层公钥加密 K-PKE 经 Fujisaki-Okamoto 变换转成 KEM，并说明「ML-KEM is believed to satisfy so-called IND-CCA2 security」；同时警告「The scheme K-PKE is not IND-CCA2-secure and shall not be used as a stand-alone scheme」。Announcement 的 §10 记录「ML-KEM is the name given to the algorithm in this standard derived from CRYSTALS-KYBER」。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in post-quantum cryptography, asymmetric public-key cryptography, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 三组参数 ML-KEM-512、ML-KEM-768、ML-KEM-1024 分别声称处于安全类别 1、3、5，表 2 对应要求的随机数发生器强度为 128、192、256 位；标准还写明「NIST recommends using ML-KEM-768 as the default parameter set」。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 标准要求解密前的输入检查与「Destruction of intermediate values」。若密文解密校验不通过，算法执行 implicit rejection：原文该步那句在本副本里把 k、c、z 三个变量印成了丢失的数学字形，因此只转述不复引——k 的值改为 c 与存于 ML-KEM 私钥中的随机值 z 的哈希；并且那个秘密标志位「returning the value of the flag as an output in any form is not permitted」。表 1 给出三组参数约 2 的负 138.8、164.8、174.8 次方的解密失败率。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: NIST IR 8547（2026 年 10 月）在 §2.1.2 记录 ML-KEM 源自 CRYSTALS-KYBER 提交，在 §3.2 说明迁移初期的混合方案「typically designed to remain secure if at least one of the component algorithms is secure」，并在 §4 规定量子脆弱的公钥密码在 2030 年后弃用、2035 年后不得在 NIST 标准与指南下使用；FIPS 203 与 FIPS 204 均于 2024 年 8 月 13 日发布。
statement.en: Registered period: Post-quantum Era.The exact date is left to the ledger; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.
